name: use-highlighted-code
title: Use Highlighted Code
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova use-highlighted-code (used by code-block), fixed: the highlighter builds with exactOptionalPropertyTypes; code's tokens are classes by kind (code-keyword, code-string, code-number, code-function, code-type, code-tag, code-property, code-comment) coloured by the theme's variables, so a change of scheme or tone colours nothing again: in colour by default, each 4.5:1 or more on the page, cards, muted surfaces, the sidebar and a line's tint in either scheme, in greys under data-code-tone="graphite" (CodeBlock's tone; keywords bold, strings lighter, comments italic); some 70 languages, each loaded when first used, and registerLanguages for an app's own (a loader and other names for it); terminal output keeps ANSI colours at 4.5:1, dimmed text (2m) a lighter step that still is, not Shiki's half opacity; a token's bold, italic, underline and strikethrough show.
